[[File:I Cant Choose Eevee.png|thumb|250px|I Can't Choose, Eevee]]
(Japanese: '''{{j|選べないよ、イーブイ}}''' ''I Can't Choose, Eievui'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] written by {{j|小森さじ}} ''Saji Komori'' and illustrated by {{j|涼森弐敷}} ''Nishiki Suzumori''. It was published on [[Poké Times]] in celebration of [[Eevee Day]], from November 21 to December 10, 2024, with two alternate endings published on January 21, 2025. It tells the story of {{OBP|Riku|I Can't Choose, Eevee}} and his {{p|Eevee}}.

The final chapter was determined by the readers, with the number of reposts from the second, third, and fourth chapters defining what path Riku would follow and what [[Eeveelution]] his Eevee would evolve into.

==Campaign==
A campaign to win a limited physical volume of the manga was held from November 21 at 8:00 PM to December 10, 2024 at 11:59 PM JST. To participate, people would have to follow [[Poké Times]] and repost all posts related to the campaign. 100 people who met the criteria were randomly selected.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20241126230226/https://www.pokemon.co.jp/info/2024/11/241122_cm01.html "I Can't Choose, Eevee" campaign | Pokémon official site] (Japanese; archived)</ref>

Winners were notified via direct message on X (Twitter) on December 20, 2024 and had until December 27, 2024 at 11:59 PM JST to fill in a form with contact information and prize delivery address. Winners began to receive their prize around January 28, 2025.
